# Clay pin and CUI wrapping patch

Upstream remains pinned to `e6cc36941ab2af5d81107617039d6f527a1c660b`:
https://github.com/nicbarker/clay/blob/e6cc36941ab2af5d81107617039d6f527a1c660b/clay.h

Unmodified upstream header SHA256:
`54aef6d5f96b14e296bebb6db4a755543e98fd7e6c188411afb2f22a4b4f7728`.
Upstream license remains the adjacent Zlib LICENSE.

The CUI local patch adds two opt-in implementation macros:

- `CLAY_CUSTOM_TEXT_MIN_WIDTH`: called after initial text measurement; may replace
  intrinsic width and minimum width for a known custom text submission.
- `CLAY_CUSTOM_TEXT_WRAP`: called after final horizontal sizing and before wrapped
  text height propagation; may publish bounded original-byte visual row slices.

Both macros are defined only while Core includes the implementation. With either
hook absent its code is omitted; with hooks present Core returns the upstream path
for ordinary text and all unwrapped text. No third-party public configuration
struct or ABI changes. The patch prevents modifying upstream word-cache entries,
so source wrapping cannot contaminate legacy cached measurement/wrap behavior.
The normal Clay current-frame width/height propagation, text rendering and clipping
still process every custom row. Core preflights the complete row count and empties
its draw list on capacity exhaustion.

Patched header SHA256:
`fda1f4cccf035d5114149a9020e10dac04e2a057fb9ca2525fb644c2004e5e4e`.
The dependency manifest checksum and distributed header must be regenerated by the
integrator when incorporating this patch. See `docs/UNICODE_WRAP.md` for runtime
source provenance, the deliberate grapheme-safe adaptation, and validation.
